messages:
maria: Quick ask - can someone run microbench comparing FlashAttention vs paged-attn + fused-kernel for long context (8k) on A100? Need p50/p95/p99 token latency, total step ms, and peak GPU memory. Also note if any OOMs.

kai: what's the model & exact config? batch size, dtype, kv cache on/off etc.

maria: LLaMA-2-13b, seq_len=8192, batch=1, fp16, KV cache enabled (typical decode path). No sampling beams, just greedy generation for ~512 tokens to exercise attention.

ashok: FYI there was a recent PR with fused attention kernels that had a subtle mem-growth on long sequences — see https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234 :mag: worth keeping in mind.

jun: I can run on a100-80GB now. Will try three kernel modes: flash, paged, fused. Posting command I will run.

jun: ```bash
python perf_runner.py --model llama2-13b --seq 8192 --bs 1 --dtype fp16 --kernels flash,paged,fused --runs 3 --gen_tokens 512 --kv_cache true
```

sophia: can you also try int8-quant (bnb) for paged-attn, and a run with cache_shards=2 (we suspected shard layout affects fused kernels)?

jun: running first set now, will post numbers shortly.

jun: quick raw results (A100-80GB, avg of 3 runs):
- flash: step=12.4 ms, p50=0.85 ms/token, p95=1.1 ms/token, p99=1.6 ms/token, peak_mem=28.2GB
- fused: step=11.9 ms, p50=0.78 ms/token, p95=1.25 ms/token, p99=1.9 ms/token, peak_mem=30.1GB (observed slight mem spike)
- paged: step=13.8 ms, p50=0.92 ms/token, p95=1.3 ms/token, p99=1.7 ms/token, peak_mem=22.4GB
No hard OOMs for 8k, fused had one retry due to allocation fragmentation on run2 but completed.

maria: great, can you rerun fused with cache_shards=2 and --prefetch_kv=true and collect CUDA memstats (+ nvprof timeline if easy)? We want to know if the spike is fragmentation or true allocation.

jun: rerun with shards=2 + prefetch. Command: `--cache_shards 2 --prefetch_kv true --collect_memstats`

jun: rerun results: fused w/ shards=2: step=12.1 ms, p50=0.80 ms/token, p95=1.15 ms/token, p99=1.6 ms/token, peak_mem=28.9GB. Memstats show short-lived allocation bursts during kv write (~1-2GB) that correlate with host->device copies. nvprof timeline attached to CI link.

sophia: paged + int8 (bnb) numbers?

jun: paged + bnb8: step=15.0 ms, p50=1.05 ms/token, p95=1.45 ms/token, p99=1.9 ms/token, peak_mem=16.8GB. Good memory savings but ~9-12% latency hit vs fp16 paged.

kai: thanks. Can you open an issue in eng-runtime, tag perf + kernel, and add the raw logs + memstats + docker image sha used for the runs? Also include the PR link ashok mentioned for context.

maria: assigning jun to follow up with a small perf PR if fused can be tuned to avoid the short allocation bursts. Please include exact flags and the runner yaml so we can reproduce.

ci-bot: Perf dashboard uploaded -> https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1769002105 (summary + nvprof timeline + docker:sha256:abc123) :white_check_mark:

ashok: small note — watch multi-stream thread-safety in fused kernels when we enable prefetch, we had a data race in a different variant. If you see nondeterministic p99s, that could be it.

maria: solid work, thanks everyone. Jun can you follow up with the issue + PR by EOD? :thumbsup:

jun: will do, filing issue & starting a branch now.
